title: Hold a petroleum exploration permit
what: Explore for petroleum only under a petroleum exploration permit or drilling reservation, or as the Act otherwise permits.

laws.title: Petroleum and Geothermal Energy Resources Act 1967 (WA)

sources.title: Petroleum and Geothermal Energy Resources Act 1967 (WA)
sources.quote: A person must not explore for petroleum or a regulated substance in the State except — (a) under and in accordance with a petroleum exploration permit or a petroleum drilling reservation; or (b) as otherwise permitted by this Act
